records.text: Candace Owens said Arizona State University became the site of an Honorary Consulate General of Romania in Arizona in 2010.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: How random. And the history of how this program developed is pretty precise. In 2010, the very year that Tyler Bowyer went over to Romania, Arizona State University became the site of an Honorary Consulate General of Romania in Arizona, effectively, just to understand that, a Romanian embassy.

verification.notes: ASU's official Romanian program page states that the program became the site of the Honorary Consulate General of Romania in Arizona in 2010.
